summary: Route MinerPass parsing and state operations through reveal-height rule contexts
details: Discovery, source comparison and canonical local parsing use the same height-selected schema. State operations validate their event context and select an explicit state-machine executor; stored passes are not reparsed under a new mint schema.
Production continues to accept only mint schema v1 with state machine v2 and the existing formulas. No network identities, persisted data formats or activation parameters change.

Isolated test executors cover schema and admission boundaries, existing pass inheritance and failed-block retry. An integration test launches the ordinary binary to verify that test-only rules cannot open business stores.
